name: Fireproof Tiara
text:
While equipped, fire spells deal 1 less damage to you.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Padded Boots
text:
While equipped, ice spells deal 1 less damage to you.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Faraday's Cloak
text:
While equipped, electricity spells deal 1 less damage to you.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Wild Fire
text:
While equipped, your fire spells deal 1 additional damage.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Dragon Glass
text:
While equipped, your ice spells deal 1 additional damage.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Tesla Coil
text:
While equipped, your electricity spells deal 1 additional damage.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Spellbook
text:
While equipped, your hand size limit increases by 1 card.
You cannot have more than one Spellbook.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Magic Cap
text:
While equipped, you can discard the Cap to avoid losing any amount of {mana} or {life} once.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.
notes: Iconos verificados con la imagen: maná (gota azul) o vida (corazón rojo).

name: Runic Armor
text:
While equipped, grants invulnerability to curses.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Scroll of Elements
text:
While equipped, you can use the Scroll of Elements anytime as a replacement for any card required by any other card.
Discard this card after use.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Transformation Glove
text:
While equipped, you can discard 1 card from your hand and draw a new one once per turn.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Twardowsky's Mirror
text:
While equipped, you can peek at the top card from the draw pile once per turn.
Place this card in front of yourself to equip it.

name: Visit of the Archmage
text:
All wizards lose 2{life} unless they immediately drink a mana potion.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.

name: Not Enough Mana
text:
Until the next event is drawn, all damage also forces victims to lose the same amount of {mana}.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.

name: Shot Glass
text:
Until the next event is drawn, drinking a mana potion provides 1{mana} less.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.
notes: La imagen muestra '1{mana} less' (pdftotext omite el icono).

name: Fire Storm
text:
Until the next event is drawn, fire spells cost 1{mana} more and deal 1 more damage.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.
notes: La imagen muestra '1{mana} more': el sobrecoste es de maná.

name: Ice Storm
text:
Until the next event is drawn, ice spells cost 1{mana} more and deal 1 more damage.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.
notes: La imagen muestra '1{mana} more': el sobrecoste es de maná.

name: Lightning Storm
text:
Until the next event is drawn, electricity spells cost 1{mana} more and deal 1 more damage.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.
notes: La imagen muestra '1{mana} more': el sobrecoste es de maná.

name: Mana Focus
text:
Until the next event is drawn, you can ignore received damage and instead lose the same amount of {mana}.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.

name: Disrupted Gravity
text:
Until the next event is drawn, each wizard's hand size limit increases by 1 card.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.

name: Blessing
text:
All wizards gain 2{life}.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.
notes: Icono verificado: vida (corazón). Con el máximo de 10 de vida.

name: Warp Discharge
text:
The wizard with the lowest amount of {mana} loses 1{life}. Other wizards gain 1{life}.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.
notes: Iconos verificados con la imagen a 250 ppp: se compara el MANÁ (gota azul) y se pierde/gana VIDA (corazón). Empate en el mínimo: pierden todos los empatados (ver docs/AMBIGUEDADES.md).

name: Elixir Transmutation
text:
All wizards can gain any amount of {life} by spending 2{mana} for each.
Play immediately after drawing, then draw a new card.
notes: Iconos verificados con la imagen a 250 ppp: se gana VIDA (corazón) pagando 2 de MANÁ (gota) por cada punto. Duración no indicada: se toma como una oportunidad única al revelarse el evento (ver docs/AMBIGUEDADES.md).

name: Anti-Joker
text: This card is useless.
notes: Anti-Joker: no entra en el mazo.
